race.comment: ZOUSLAYER (2) drifted well back last start before winding up strongly to finish third, beaten 1.5 lengths, over 1000m at Sunshine Coast. Draws favourably in gate two and will prove very tough to stop. PEACH GALANTES (9) just missed the placings two runs back then didn't feature last start when 6 lengths away in seventh over 1100m at Gatton. Suitably placed in this contest so anticipating a better run this time. WHITTAKER (6) will be ready to peak now third run back from the break and may earn some minor money. CAUSEWAYS (4) last appeared three-and-a-half weeks ago over 1400m at Goondiwindi when he finished sixth. This is his first run for the Ravyn Warzecha stable. Gets 2kg weight relief with the claim and should be thereabouts.
